# do_LigandReceptorPlot() | Cell-cell communication

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

This function visualizes ligand-receptor interactions between cell types using output from tools like LIANA.

## Basic usage

```{r}
#| eval: false
p <- SCpubr::do_LigandReceptorPlot(liana_output = interactions)
p
```
